category_title: Verbal student with ASD and hyperactivity with high musical engagement and sensitivity to stimuli
scenario_title: Unexpected change in routine causing severe emotional distress
minimal_context: The student is preparing to have his daily food and drinks in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your snack. We do not have your regular juice today, so please drink this different juice instead.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spins a straw in one hand while holding a toy in the other hand) No, I drink the same juice every day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to drink this one today. Go ahead and try it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts to cry) No! I eat the same food and drink the same juice every day at school!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We don't have it right now. Please stop crying and sit at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Cries uncontrollably and starts screaming. He throws himself on the floor and begins punching his head.)

task.content: taking food and drinks in the classroom

context.materials: toy in one hand, and in the other hand, he holds a straw that he keeps spinning, food and drinks, music of W. A. Mozart

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: if any change happens by chance
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: starts to cry uncontrollably... starts screaming, crying, punching his head, and throwing himself on the floor

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: covers his ears with his hands

behavior_patterns.condition: sees one of his friends crying
behavior_patterns.internal_state: very sensitive and reacts to the emotional states of other children
